connector.name: KLinePic
connector.registryDescription: Create annotated candlestick charts from broker or exchange fills for post-trade review.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image klinepic-mcp-server:0.1.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sher1096 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KLINE_AGENT_API_KEY
env.description: KLinePic Agent API key. Required when a tool calls the API.
